posts.author: Dutchelm05
posts.content_md:
Thank you everyone, it is great to get feedback from experienced holographers. The best thing about this subject is that the gold of the object came through. 

So to answer any questions (gladly)

This was done per John's procedure, I have it taped on my bench like a bible. I use veil/spin (for now).

My process is just standard.

As for the lighting. The photo does not do the actual hologram justice. It is much more crisp. Not only will I try the photographing techniques you have suggested but also try a different light source as well. I just recieced a white LED sold for holographic display (I hope it was worth the 40 bucks:). 

Thanks again to you all, I could not have done it without the awesome help I have recieved especially from John.

But as Dave has said, consistency is key, and I need to duplicate if not improve on it each time to really say I got it. 

Tony
